news.title: Opening statements begin in long-awaited trial in Tupac Shakur's 1996 killing
news.summary: Duane "Keffe D" Davis is charged with murder in the 1996 killing of the legendary rapper. Davis is the first person to be charged in connection to the musician's death, nearly 30 years after he was killed in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas
